messages.subject: DRUG this week: ggplot()
parts:
Hello all,

Thanks for a great first meeting of DRUG on Friday!  We have a diverse mix of users of all levels and interests, and we will learn a lot from each other.

On Friday we agreed that it would be helpful to start each Friday workshop with a ~20 minute presentation of one of these types:

1. How to do [x] in R
2. I have this project and I'm trying to do [x] in R, give me feedback on how!
3. Look at this cool thing I did in R.

This week Mike and I will be giving a quick introduction to ggplot(), an excellent tool for data exploration and producing beautiful plots. I'm collecting resources related to ggplot in this google doc: http://goo.gl/kQqIx.  If you have favorite ggplot resources or examples, please drop them in!

Next week Jacob will give a presentation on his work in R doing spatial analysis on transportation data.

I'll also compile a list of proposed topics and a sign-up for presentation in a bit. See you Friday!

Noam
